name: Archaeological Site of Olympia
description: Tucked into a green valley on Greece's Peloponnese peninsula, Olympia was the sanctuary of Zeus and the birthplace of the Olympic Games, first held here in 776 B.C. Visitors can walk among toppled temple columns and the remains of the ancient training and competition grounds. The simple earthen stadium, where athletes once entered through a vaulted archway, still stands, and it set the length of the Greek stadion.
